desc:
🐦 Welcome to Ride Birds & Steal Eggs!
✨ Ride flying birds, find eggs on floating islands, and use spider silk to bring them back for hatching!

🎮 Gameplay:
🌤️ Ride flying birds and travel across floating islands to hunt for animal eggs
🕸️ Use spider silk to carry the eggs back
🥚 Hatch animal eggs to collect creatures
💰 Earn money from your animals
🔧 Unlock new mounts, bases and treadmills
🏃 Train on treadmills to boost your speed
🏝️ Discover distant floating islands and rarer eggs

💡 Tip: Drop eggs to refresh your spider‑silk durability
